original: Target headed my way and not stopping. Engage and neutralize the target. Don't let him through.
translation: 目标朝我这边来了，没打算停车。开火消灭目标，别让他过去。

original: Target is approaching. Intercept and neutralize. Roger that.
translation: 目标正在接近。拦截并消灭。收到。

original: Target inbound. Adjust your position and engage.
translation: 目标逼近。调整位置，开火。

original: Unit 12, you're to intercept your target at all costs. Roger that. I'll move and shoot. Over.
translation: 12号小队，不惜一切代价拦截你的目标。收到。我一边移动一边射击。完毕。

original: Explosives are ready to detonate. Destroy that vehicle! Over!
translation: 炸药已就绪，可以引爆。摧毁那辆车！完毕！

original: Base to Bomb Unit 5, you must stop this vehicle. Explosives are in place! Target is coming!
translation: 总部呼叫爆破5号小队，必须拦下这辆车。炸药已布置好！目标来了！

original: Sir, I'm in position. Explosives are a go. Blow him up, soldier!
translation: 长官，我已就位。炸药可以引爆。炸了他，士兵！

original: Base to B unit, are you done setting up the charges? Yes, sir! I can see the target! I'm ready!
translation: 总部呼叫B小队，炸药布置好了吗？是的，长官！我看到目标了！我准备好了！

original: Unit 7 to base. I'm behind cover, awaiting target. Proceed with caution! Don't let him see you!
translation: 7号小队呼叫总部。我在掩体后等待目标。谨慎行动！别让他看见你！

original: Sir, the target can't see me. I'm about to engage. Roger that. Use the element of surprise. Over.
translation: 长官，目标看不见我。我准备开火了。收到。利用出其不意。完毕。

original: Stay hidden. Prepare to engage. Affirmative. Target is approaching.
translation: 保持隐蔽，准备开火。收到。目标正在接近。

original: Sir, he's coming! What are your orders? Stay behind cover. Engage as he passes.
translation: 长官，他来了！有何指示？待在掩体后，等他经过时开火。

original: Update requested! Spike strip deployed. Target approaching. Roger that! You must stop this vehicle!
translation: 请求最新情况！破胎钉已部署。目标正在接近。收到！必须拦下这辆车！

original: Sir, spikes are ready! Roger that! Stop your target!
translation: 长官，破胎钉准备好了！收到！拦下你的目标！

original: Spike's unit to base. Target coming my way. Blow his tires! Stop him! Over!
translation: 破胎钉小队呼叫总部。目标朝我来了。打爆他的轮胎！拦住他！完毕！

original: Unit 9, is the Spike Strip deployed? Yes, sir! The target is approaching! You must stop that car, soldier! Yes, sir!
translation: 9号小队，破胎钉部署了吗？是的，长官！目标正在接近！必须拦下那辆车，士兵！是，长官！

original: S.T.A.R.G.E.T. is in my sights! S.T.A.R.G.E.T. Your orders are to shoot him down!
translation: 目标进入我的瞄准镜！目标。命令是把他打下来！

original: TARGET IS HEADING MY WAY! Shoot that bastard!
translation: 目标朝我来了！打死那王八蛋！

original: Here he comes! Light him up!
translation: 他来了！开火把他打成筛子！

original: I see him! Shoot that bastard!
translation: 我看见他了！打死那王八蛋！

original: Target in sight. Orders? What do you think?
translation: 目标进入视野。有何指示？你说呢？

original: You have got to be kidding me!
You have got to be kidding me!
That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: That's all I can do right now.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些了。

original: Hellfire 26 to Humvee, do you copy?
translation: 地狱火26呼叫悍马，是否收到？

original: Hellfire 26 to Humvee, do you copy?
translation: 地狱火26呼叫悍马，是否收到？

original: Hellfire 26 to Humvee, do you copy?
translation: 地狱火26呼叫悍马，是否收到？

original: Air support! Need your help now!
translation: 空中支援！现在需要你的帮助！

original: This place is gone! Take us out of here!
translation: 这地方完了！带我们离开这儿！

original: Let's get out of here. There's no hope.

translation: 我需要更好的射击角度！

original: Bring us down! We have civilians here!
Found a spot! Get us down!
translation: 找到地方了！让我们降落！

original: The zombies are gone! Come out!
It's safe now! You can come!
translation: 现在安全了！你们可以出来了！
*哼哼* 干掉它！*哼哼* 把它弄下去！*哼哼* *哼哼* *尖叫*

original: SHIT! Stay with me, Diane! DIANE! DIANE!
translation: 妈的！撑住，黛安！黛安！黛安！

original: Dianne, you okay? DIANNE! NO! SHIT! AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
translation: 黛安，你还好吗？黛安！不！妈的！啊啊啊啊啊啊！

original: Don't die, Diane! DIANE! Fuck! Wake up! DIANE!
translation: 别死，黛安！黛安！操！醒醒！黛安！

original: Don't let him on the hood!
Diane, hold on. Shake it off.
Hey! HEY! Keep it together! You're not dead!
translation: 喂！喂！给我撑住！你还没死！

original: AAAAAAAAGH! FUCK! GET IT OFF ME! AAH FUCK! AAAAAAAAGH! AAAAAAAAGH! AAAAAAAAGH! AAH! AAH! OUCH!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！操！把它弄下去！啊操！啊啊啊啊！啊啊啊啊！啊啊啊啊！啊！啊！疼！

original: Get back here! We leave now!
Come on! We don't have all day!
translation: 快点！我们没那么多时间！

original: Move it! We're sitting ducks here!
translation: 快点！我们在这儿就是活靶子！

original: Huh, huh, huh, huh, huh, huh, huh, huh, huh, huh.
translation: 呼，呼，呼，呼，呼，呼，呼，呼，呼，呼。

original: Huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff.
We're not stopping, you get that?
translation: 我们不会停车，你听明白了吗？

original: Coward! Come down here to fight me!
Watch out! We got a chopper on our ass!
translation: 小心！有架直升机盯上我们了！

original: Yeah, and I'll shoot these fools!
Come on, come on, come on!
Look there! That's one of them! Watch out!
translation: 看那边！那就是其中一个！小心！

original: Stop the car and try to fix it. I'll keep watch.
translation: 停车，试着修一下。我来放哨。

original: Come on, start the car and fix the radio!
It works, but it has a limited frequency range. We won't get everything.
translation: 能用了，但频率范围有限。收不到所有信号。

original: I'll get some of these meds!
The armor's banged up! I'll put it back together!
translation: 装甲被撞坏了！我来修好它！

original: Hey! I'm putting on new tires!
Hey, new weapon here! Let me get it!
translation: 喂，这儿有新武器！我去拿！

original: I'll reinforce our bumper! We won't make it otherwise!
translation: 我来加固车头！不然我们撑不下去！

original: We need better tires! Gimme a sec!
translation: 我们需要更好的轮胎！等我一下！

original: Give me a sec! I'll tune up this weapon!
translation: 等我一下！我来调校这把武器！
轮胎磨没了，铁都蹭地了！
我们现在需要空中支援！

original: We're not going to save anyone here today. We're leaving.
translation: 今天在这儿救不了任何人了。我们撤。

original: Move forward! I need a good shot!
translation: 往前！我需要好的射击角度！

original: Got a safe house down there!
You can leave this place, come on!
translation: 你们可以离开这里了，快！

original: We're not done with that one!
Help me! Push it off! No! Push it off! Help!
translation: 帮我！把它推下去！不！把它推下去！救命！

original: DON'T DIE ON ME, COCHETTA! COCHETTA, COME ON! NOOOO!
translation: 别死在我面前，科切塔！科切塔，醒醒！不——！

original: No! Stay with me! Stay with me! Coachella!
Coachella, you okay? Stay with me.
Come on, get it together! You're right!
translation: 快点，振作起来！你没事的！

original: I can't do it! There's no time!
I'll be done in a sec!
I'm going back in the city!
- Ah! Ah! - Diane, no! - Ah! Help! - Ah!
translation: - 啊！啊！ - 黛安，不要！ - 啊！救命！ - 啊！
你撞死了一个无辜的人！
我们不能待在这儿，科切塔。

original: We're not safe here! Are you done?
translation: 这儿不安全！你弄完了吗？

original: Huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff, huff.
Fuck, how can it come to this?
Will they give us a freaking break?
translation: 他们就不能让我们喘口气吗？

original: We're not infected! Let us go, dammit!
translation: 我们没被感染！放我们走，妈的！

original: Let's go! We can't stay here!
translation: 走啊！我们不能待在这儿！

original: Yeah, I'll buy you some time.
DAMN IT, UH, GET OFF, GET OFF, UH, GET OFF, UH, UH, GET OFF OF ME, UH, UH!
translation: 妈的，呃，下去，下去，呃，下去，呃，呃，从我身上下去，呃，呃！

original: Well, stop the car and see if you can fix it. I'll keep him away.
translation: 那就停车，看能不能修好。我来挡住他。

original: Hey, stop the car! Gotta fix the radio!
Cochita, stop the car, damn it!
Alright, got it. The frequency range is narrow, though. We'll only get some of the comms.
translation: 好，搞定了。不过频率范围很窄，只能收到部分通讯。

original: There are meds here. I'll get some.
I'll mount this weapon on the Hummer.
translation: 我把这个武器装到悍马上。

original: Give me some time. This'll help.
translation: 给我点时间。这个会有用。

original: Our armor plating needs some work! I'm on it!
translation: 我们的装甲板得修修了！我来搞定！

original: Wait, I'm getting a new weapon!
We need a stronger armor plating if we want to survive!
translation: 想活命就得要更结实的装甲板！

original: Hey, got some better tires here. I'll put them on.
translation: 喂，这儿有更好的轮胎。我来换上。

original: I can get more out of this gun! Hold on!
translation: 我能让这把枪发挥更大威力！等等！

original: It's working, sir! We're taking off!
translation: 成功了，长官！我们起飞了！

original: What's the status on the undead activity?
Let's pray to whoever's still up there that we did the right thing.
translation: 向天上还听得到的人祈祷吧，但愿我们做对了。

original: To all military personnel, this is General Sherman. We're transferring all our communications to secure channels. Complete your current orders and report directly to your superiors. Follow the chain of command and we will prevail. Godspeed. Sherman out.
translation: 全体军事人员注意，我是谢尔曼将军。我们将把所有通讯切换到加密频道。完成当前命令，直接向上级汇报。遵守指挥链，我们终将获胜。祝各位好运。谢尔曼完毕。

original: Prevail? What the fuck are you talking about?
Hope is the best I can give them right now.
translation: 现在我能给他们的，只有希望了。

original: Sherman to Prescott, do you copy?
translation: 谢尔曼呼叫普雷斯科特，是否收到？

original: Sherman to Transport Unit 1. What is your position?
translation: 谢尔曼呼叫运输1号小队。你们在什么位置？
谢尔曼呼叫反运输小队，请回话！

original: You really think they had time? You sacrificed them all for nothing.
translation: 你真觉得他们来得及？你白白牺牲了他们所有人。

original: Sherman to Powell! Do you copy?!
translation: 谢尔曼呼叫鲍威尔！是否收到？！

original: Damn! Can't reach any of the other cities.
translation: 该死！联系不上其他任何城市。

original: This is happening in other cities?
translation: 其他城市也在发生这种事？
谢尔曼呼叫卡斯珀，请回话。

original: Full retreat! Save your man now!
translation: 全体撤退！马上救你的人！

original: Outbreaks started all over the country. Cities were cut off. Media blockouts put in place. It hit us so fast in so many places, we spread too thin. It was all on a need-to-know basis. Now HQ's gone. We're scattered.
translation: 疫情在全国各地爆发。城市被封锁。媒体全面屏蔽。它来得太快，波及太广，我们兵力太分散。一切都按需知密进行。现在总部没了，我们四分五裂。

original: Folesky, how much fuel we got?
translation: 福莱斯基，我们还有多少燃料？
你就不能联系更多的人吗？

original: I had my people down the chain of command, HQ had theirs. We're cut off now. Casper is my only remaining unit. I want to fly north, meet with them outside of Alliance. A small town we could scout, take back if need be, fortify and defend. What do you say, boys?
translation: 我的人分布在指挥链下方，总部也有他们的人。现在我们被切断了。卡斯珀是我仅剩的部队。我想往北飞，在阿莱恩斯城外与他们会合。那是个小镇，我们可以侦察，必要时夺回来，加固防御。你们觉得呢，小伙子们？

original: Is it a good plan, ma'am?
Casper, get out of the city and head north. Get your men to the outskirts of Alliance. We're flying to you.
translation: 卡斯珀，出城往北走。带你的部队到阿莱恩斯郊外。我们飞过去与你们会合。
来人啊，求求你们帮帮我们！

original: I gotta get out of here!
NO! THEY'RE TRYING TO KILL ME!
I must be dreaming! I must be dreaming!
translation: 我一定是在做梦！我一定是在做梦！

original: This is the end of the world!
Please, somebody help me! Oh God!
translation: 求求你们，谁来帮帮我！哦，天哪！

original: They ate my baby! My baby!
translation: 他们吃了我的孩子！我的孩子！

original: Don't they die from a bullet to the head?
translation: 它们不是爆头就会死吗？

original: Yeah, but I heard you have to hit specific parts of the brain to flip their switch off.
translation: 是啊，但我听说得打中大脑的特定部位才能让它们彻底断电。

original: UNIT 8 to base! We need artillery fire on the north side part now! Negative, UNIT 8. Artillery has been proven ineffective against the undead. Maintain current strategy.
translation: 8号小队呼叫总部！我们需要炮火支援北区，现在就要！否定，8号小队。炮击已被证明对丧尸无效。维持当前战术。

original: Unit 10 to base! We're surrounded on the east side factory! Requesting airlift now! Over! Denied. Secure position and await orders. Requesting airlift ASAP! We're getting in with...
translation: 10号小队呼叫总部！我们在东区工厂被包围了！请求立即空运撤离！完毕！驳回。守住阵地，等待命令。请求尽快空运！我们快顶不住了……

original: We need back up! This is Unit 12 on Burgundy Street! The Humvee has turned over and we're... surrounded! Ah! Shit! Please repeat that, Unit 12! What is your position? Oh my God! Ah! Shit! The tracks are down in heat! Unit 12! Unit 12! Please respond!
translation: 我们需要增援！我是勃艮第街上的12号小队！悍马翻了，我们……被包围了！啊！妈的！请重复，12号小队！你在什么位置？天哪！啊！妈的！车队被火力压制！12号小队！12号小队！请回答！

original: Central Plaza is completely overrun! We need to pull back everybody! Pull back to Central now! Denied. You are to hold positions. They're killing everyone! It's all over! We've lost Central! I repeat, we have lost Central!
translation: 中央广场彻底失守了！我们必须全员后撤！立刻撤到中央！驳回。你们必须守住阵地。它们在杀光所有人！全完了！我们丢了中央！重复，我们丢掉了中央！

original: This is Unit 17! Descends are spilling through the barricades! Our position is completely compromised! Over! Pull back to Section 11 and hold position, Unit 17! Orders received! We are pulling back!
translation: 我是17号小队！丧尸正涌过路障！我方阵地彻底暴露！完毕！撤到11区守住阵地，17号小队！收到命令！我们正在后撤！

original: Initiating carpet bombing on all designated targets. Over. Acknowledged.
translation: 开始对所有指定目标实施地毯式轰炸。完毕。确认收到。

original: This is Hellfire. My chopper is heavily damaged. I must abort. Return to base immediately. Over.
translation: 我是地狱火。我的直升机严重受损，必须中止行动。立即返回基地。完毕。

original: Hellfire to base! We've taken heavy damage! Retreating for emergency landing! Roger that. Proceed to east side base.
translation: 地狱火呼叫总部！我们受损严重！撤退进行紧急迫降！收到。前往东区基地。

original: Face to Hellfire! Engage target! Take him down! Roger that! Engaging target!
translation: 总部呼叫地狱火！开火攻击目标！把他打下来！收到！正在攻击目标！

original: This is Hellfire. Permission to engage the target. Over. Permission granted. Engage the target. Over.
translation: 我是地狱火。请求允许攻击目标。完毕。准许。攻击目标。完毕。

original: Hellfire to base. I request permission to use air-to-ground missiles. Granted. Over.
translation: 地狱火呼叫总部。请求允许使用空对地导弹。准许。完毕。

original: Base to Hellfire, take your target down now. You have permission to use air-to-ground missiles. Affirmative. Over.
translation: 总部呼叫地狱火，现在把目标打下来。准许使用空对地导弹。确认。完毕。

original: This is futile! Your escape attempt will get you killed!
translation: 这是徒劳的！你的逃跑只会害死你自己！

original: STOP, OR YOUR VEHICLE WILL BE DESTROYED!
translation: 停车，否则你的车将被摧毁！

original: STOP OR YOUR VEHICLE WILL BE DESTROYED!
translation: 停车，否则你的车将被摧毁！

original: Stop now! This is a matter of national security!
translation: 立刻停车！这关乎国家安全！

original: There's no way out. Stop and surrender!
The city is quarantined. You can't leave.
translation: 城市已隔离。你不能离开。

original: Face to air support, highway target is not stopping. We need a carpet bombing on his location. Affirmative. Approaching target.
translation: 总部呼叫空中支援，高速上的目标没有停车。我们需要对他的位置实施地毯式轰炸。收到。正在接近目标。

original: This is air support approaching drop zone. Permission to engage, over. Permission granted. Engage.
translation: 我是空中支援，正在接近投放区。请求允许攻击，完毕。准许。攻击。

original: Target hit, but not neutralized. Roger that. Return to base for refueling.
translation: 击中目标，但未消灭。收到。返回基地加油。

original: It's a hit! It's a hit! Target is still going, though. That should slow him down. Let the ground unit handle the rest. Return to base.
translation: 击中了！击中了！不过目标还在前进。这应该能拖慢他。剩下的交给地面部队。返回基地。

original: Target missed. I repeat, target missed. I'm out of ammo. Damn it! Return to base. Over.
translation: 未击中目标。重复，未击中目标。我没弹药了。该死！返回基地。完毕。

original: Air support to base. I missed. Come back to base for a refill.
translation: 空中支援呼叫总部。我打偏了。返回基地补给。

original: That's a miss. Target still going. Circle around and hit him again.
translation: 打偏了。目标还在前进。绕一圈再打他一次。

original: No hit, sir. The target is alive. Hit him once more. Now! Yes, sir!
translation: 没打中，长官。目标还活着。再打他一次。现在！是，长官！

original: I need a sit-rep. Target missed, sir. Hit him again!
translation: 我需要战况报告。没打中，长官。再打他一次！

original: You are going to get us all killed!
God, stop the car! Let me in! Please!
translation: 天哪，停车！让我上去！求你了！

original: WAH HA HA HA! WAH HA HA HA HA!
THE WORLD IS ENDING! OH GOD, THE WORLD IS ENDING!
translation: 世界要完了！哦天哪，世界要完了！

original: THERE'S NOWHERE TO RUN! THERE'S NOWHERE TO RUN!
translation: 没地方跑了！没地方跑了！

original: I CAN'T FIND MY CAR KEYS! AHHHHH!
translation: 我找不到车钥匙了！啊啊啊啊！
我的圣母玛利亚啊，为什么啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊

original: THERE'S TOO MANY OF THEM WILL EVER SURVIVE!
translation: 他们太多了，没人能活下来！

original: THEY'RE COMING! PLEASE STOP! PICK ME UP, PLEASE!
translation: 他们来了！求求你停下！载上我，求你了！

original: MY WIFE AND FAMILY ARE DEAD! THEY'RE DEAD!
translation: 我老婆和家人全死了！全死了！

original: THEY'RE SHOOTING EVERYONE! THEY WON'T LET ANYBODY LEAVE!
translation: 他们见人就开枪！不让任何人离开！

original: Don't let him kill us now!
No, you can't leave! No, my family will be killed!
translation: 不，你不能走！不，我家人会被杀的！

original: No! Don't get us if you leave us here!
translation: 不！你走了就是把我们丢在这儿等死！

original: Stop! Wait! Don't leave without us!

translation: 这地方就是个死亡陷阱！

original: Yeah, let's get out of here.
For the last time, you have to regroup with the other units!
translation: 最后一次警告，你必须和其他部队重新集结！

original: No way! Going south is a death sentence! We're going west, out of the city!
translation: 不可能！往南就是送死！我们要往西，撤出城！

original: ATTENTION ALL UNITS, WE HAVE A HOSTILE VEHICLE IN SECTOR 629 GOING WEST, POSSIBLY INFECTED, INTERCEPT AND SHOOT ON SIGHT.
translation: 所有部队注意，629区域有一辆向西行驶的敌对车辆，可能已被感染，拦截并见即开火。

original: I don't know! We're in serious trouble!
translation: 我不知道！我们麻烦大了！

original: We can make it! Let's go!
I'm getting the hell out of here!
translation: 我得赶紧离开这鬼地方！

original: SHIT! SHIT! MOVE OUT OF THE WAY!
Oh, my God! Out of the way!
I can't stop! I just can't!
translation: 我停不下来！真的停不下来！

original: You made it! Step in and cover the west side!
translation: 你们赶到了！上来，守住西侧！

original: We're moving in. Target is stationary!
translation: 我们正在靠近。目标静止不动！

original: We're closing in on the target now.
Stop the car, you son of a bitch!
YOU'RE A DEAD MAN, YOU KNOW THAT?
When I stop this car, you're going down, dirtbag!
translation: 等我把这车停下，你就完了，混蛋！

original: You're wasting your time, you piece of shit!
translation: 你在浪费时间，你这废物！

original: I'M GONNA ENJOY RIPPING YOUR FACE OFF!
translation: 撕烂你的脸，我会很享受！

original: Thank you. We crashed our Humvee. I was with the Kilo-5 patrol unit. Got surrounded so fast, they... they all died. What's your name?
translation: 谢谢。我们的悍马翻了。我是Kilo-5巡逻队的。被包围得太快，他们……他们都死了。你叫什么名字？

original: Protector Solomon Delta 2 unit, and you?
translation: 守护者所罗门，三角洲2号小队。你呢？
我是黛安，黛安·雷斯沃斯。

original: Yeah, I'm better. Where are we going? What's going on?
translation: 嗯，好多了。我们去哪？到底怎么回事？

original: We're losing control! Gotta get out of the city!
translation: 局面失控了！必须撤出城！

original: No, we have to regroup with the other units.
translation: 不行，我们得和其他部队重新集结。

original: What other units? Look around you! No, we keep driving west to the edge of the city.
translation: 还有什么部队？你看看四周！不行，我们继续往西开到城边。

original: Okay, we do it your way.
Would be good to have contact with our people. Can we fix it?
translation: 能和弟兄们联系上就好了。能修好吗？

original: Unit 11 to base! Brighton Bridge is completely overrun! We need a new fallback position, NOW! Uh, set up the fence... at the... Chinatown Plaza. Sir? We just came from there! Ugh, goddammit! Just move north! Just move freaking north! Yes, sir!
translation: 11号小队呼叫基地！布莱顿大桥已完全失守！我们需要新的撤退集结点，立刻！呃，把防线设在……唐人街广场。长官？我们刚从那儿来！呃，真他妈的！就往北撤！就往北撤！是，长官！

original: So what do we do? Do we go north?
translation: 那我们怎么办？往北撤吗？

original: Are you crazy? They're panicked. They're saying anything.
translation: 你疯了吗？他们都慌了，什么都说得出来。

original: Maybe you're right, but it's dangerous to stay on our own.
translation: 也许你说得对，但就我们几个太危险了。

original: You heard them. Entire regiments got overrun. We're better off in small numbers.
translation: 你也听到了。整团整团地被击溃。人少反而更好。

original: Were you part of the Flatline operation? We've been fighting these things for almost a week.
translation: 你参加过平线行动吗？我们和这些东西打了快一周了。

original: No, I came in two days ago. It was pretty bad already.
translation: 没有，我两天前才到。那时就已经很糟了。

original: But it seemed like we were still in control, even this morning. Still got coherent orders and all.
translation: 但看起来我们还在掌控局面，今天早上都还是。命令也还算清楚。

original: That's what HQ wanted you to think. This is way over their head.
translation: 那是总部想让你以为的。这早超出他们的能力了。

original: Doesn't make sense. I never thought we'd be overwhelmed like this.
translation: 说不通。我从没想过我们会这样被击溃。

original: WE'VE NEVER FOUGHT A BATTLE LIKE THIS!
translation: 我们从没打过这样的仗！

original: Listen, I know you think we're better off by ourselves, but I'm going to contact HQ to get a clear picture.
translation: 听着，我知道你觉得我们单独行动更好，但我要联系总部，弄清情况。

original: HQ, this is Kilo-5 reporting. Do you copy? HQ, this is Kilo-5 reporting. Do you copy?
translation: 总部，这里是Kilo-5报到。收到吗？总部，这里是Kilo-5报到。收到吗？

original: My squad is dead. I gotta pick up. We need orders. We're near, uh, Burlington and Lake. Over.
translation: 我的小队全死了。我得重新收拢。我们需要命令。我们在，呃，伯灵顿和莱克附近。完毕。

original: Um, move north to regroup, over
translation: 呃，往北撤，重新集结，完毕。

original: Regroup where, with who? Kilo-5 to HQ, regroup where? HQ, do you copy?
translation: 在哪集结，和谁集结？Kilo-5呼叫总部，在哪集结？总部，收到吗？

original: "Kocheta, you know most of the city has been covered with spike strips and mines three days ago, right?"
translation: 「科切塔，你知道三天前城里大部分地方都布满了钉刺带和地雷，对吧？」

original: Yeah, it was in the briefing. This is gonna be a problem.
translation: 知道，简报里提过。这会是个麻烦。

original: Checkpoint to base. We're in trouble here. We need orders. Maintain current strategy. We're about to be overrun. The current strategy is shit. I repeat, maintain current strategy. What? What the hell is going on?
translation: 检查站呼叫基地。我们这边有麻烦了。我们需要命令。维持现有策略。我们快被击溃了。现有策略就是狗屎。重复，维持现有策略。什么？到底怎么回事？

original: We thought we could be arrogant. Turn this planet into a dump and not pay-
translation: 我们自以为可以狂妄。把这星球当垃圾场糟蹋，还不付——

original: Don't give me that nature-loving bullshit, Cochita. This is not karma or whatever you want to call it. Let's just focus on getting the hell out of here, all right?
translation: 别跟我扯什么热爱自然那套鬼话，科切塔。这不是报应，也不是你想叫的什么。我们还是专心逃出这鬼地方，行吗？

original: Did we just go through Greater Renton?
translation: 我们刚才是穿过大伦顿了吗？

original: I had a buddy from P-Squad who told me they were neutralizing the civilians beyond this area with motion detection mines.
translation: 我有个P-Squad的兄弟告诉我，他们用运动感应地雷在消灭这片区域外的平民。

original: It blows up when you get close. A last-ditch effort to keep people from moving all around the city. Stop traffic and all that.
translation: 你一靠近它就会炸。这是最后的办法，防止人们在全城乱跑。阻断交通之类的。

original: Attention all troops. This is General Sherman. I am taking command of this operation. We're facing an enemy like we've never seen before. But keep your heads cool, and we're going to get through this. Now follow my orders carefully. All ground personnel are to converge to a defensive line along the Aachi River. Our backs to the water. We'll meet a final stand in one single direction. We also have reports that some zombies have mutated. Be aware they are very strong and should be avoided at all costs.
translation: 全体部队注意。我是谢尔曼将军。我现在接管这次行动。我们面对的敌人前所未见。但要保持冷静，我们一定能挺过去。现在仔细听从我的命令。所有地面人员向阿奇河沿岸的防线集结。背水一战。我们要朝着一个方向做最后的死守。另外有报告称，部分丧尸已经发生变异。注意，它们非常强悍，务必不惜一切代价避开。

original: Mutated? What is he talking about?
I don't know, and the Achi River is on the other side of the city.
translation: 我不知道，而且阿奇河在城的另一头。

original: No way! We'll never make it alive!
translation: 绝不可能！我们根本活不到那儿！

original: We keep going west. It's our best bet. We're not that far.
translation: 继续往西。这是我们最好的选择。我们不远了。

original: Hey, I think we're in Clifton Square. Isn't that where they tried to make a stand yesterday?
translation: 嘿，我想我们到克利夫顿广场了。不就是昨天他们想死守的地方吗？

original: Yeah, you're right! Look at this place! It was a massacre!
translation: 对，你说得没错！看看这地方！简直是一场屠杀！

original: What were they thinking doing this here? We lost so many people!
translation: 他们怎么会在这儿打？我们折了那么多人！

original: It's test people deciding for field units. No wonder we're this steep in shit.
translation: 是些坐办公室的在替前线部队做决定。难怪我们陷得这么深。

original: Dispatch to air squadron. We need a carpet bombing west of Juno Street. Affirmative. We're on our way.
translation: 调度呼叫空军中队。我们需要对朱诺街以西进行地毯式轰炸。收到。我们马上出发。

original: Whoa, shit! That's right on us!
Kilo 5 to Dispatch, we're near Juno Street. Call off the carpet bombing. Dispatch, call off the Juno Street bombing.
translation: Kilo-5呼叫调度，我们在朱诺街附近。取消地毯式轰炸。调度，取消朱诺街的轰炸。

original: Fuck! Here they come! Brace yourself!
translation: 妈的！它们来了！准备迎战！

original: Hold on tight. It's gonna be rough. You're going straight to a hot zone. I'll help you as much as I can.
translation: 抓稳了。会很难熬。你们这是直接往火坑里冲。我会尽量帮你们。

original: Hellfire 26 to Humvee, do you copy?
translation: 地狱火26呼叫悍马，收到吗？

original: Yes, we copy. This is Kilo-5. Can you help us?
translation: 收到。这里是Kilo-5。你能帮我们吗？

original: What the hell are you doing out here? You're supposed to regroup at the Aachi River!
translation: 你们到底在外面干什么？你们本该去阿奇河集结！

original: We're going west, can you help us or not?
translation: 我们要往西走，你到底帮不帮？

original: West Side is completely overrun. Going further is suicide. There's a transport operation on Highway 65 right now. Can you make it there?
translation: 西区已完全失守。再往前就是送死。65号公路上现在有个运输行动。你们能赶到吗？

original: There's a highway ramp a couple kilometers ahead. Can you give us air support?
translation: 前面几公里有个公路匝道。能给我们空中支援吗？

original: Only for a little while. I got a rendezvous with the Highway Troops ASAP.
translation: 只能一小会儿。我得尽快和公路部队会合。

original: That's all I can do right now. Get to the highway as fast as you can. Most transports are en route or on their way back already. Good luck. Over.
translation: 我现在只能做到这些。尽快赶到公路。大部分运输机已经在途中，或者已经返航了。祝你们好运。完毕。

original: The wrap should be close by now.
Alright, let's find us a transport out of here!
translation: 好了，我们找架运输机离开这儿！

original: Whoa, check out this jacked-up car.
translation: 哇，看看这辆改装过的车。
该死的运输机都去哪了？！

original: Kilo 5 to Hellfire 26, do you copy?
Kilo-5, please tell me you're on a transport.
translation: Kilo-5，求你别告诉我你们没上运输机。

original: THERE WAS NO TRANSPORT, YOU ASSHOLE!
translation: 根本就没有运输机，你这混蛋！

original: You were too late! We're all en route to Ayachi River! I'm very sorry.
translation: 你们来晚了！我们全都在前往阿奇河的路上！非常抱歉。

original: i'm i i can't help you good luck stay alive over
translation: 我……我帮不了你们，祝好运，活下来。完毕。

original: There's a tunnel at the end of this highway. It's probably what our jackass was going for.
translation: 这条公路尽头有个隧道。那混蛋八成就是冲着那儿去的。

original: Dispatch, send all transport choppers to the Aiachi River Bank. We're evacuating the area. Yes, sir. Phantom Eagle, what is your position? Phantom Eagle to base. I'm currently at 64.7 and 32.4, heading to 79, over. Roger that. Maintain current course, over.
translation: 调度，把所有运输直升机派到阿奇河岸。我们要撤离这一带。是，长官。幻影鹰，你的位置？幻影鹰呼叫基地。我目前在64.7和32.4，正前往79，完毕。收到。保持当前航向，完毕。

original: SHIT! YOU KNOW WHAT THAT MEANS?
translation: 妈的！你知道那意味着什么吗？

original: We probably don't have much time. 20 minutes tops. At this speed, we're not going to make it to the tunnel. We're not going to make it anywhere.
translation: 我们估计没多少时间了。最多20分钟。照这速度，我们到不了隧道。哪儿都到不了。
那怎么办？啊？到底怎么办？！

original: If you didn't insist on going west, we'd be above ground right now.
translation: 要不是你非要往西，我们现在都在地面上了。

original: We could have went north like everyone else! We could have gotten a transport in time!
translation: 我们本可以像别人一样往北撤！本可以及时登上运输机的！

original: For all we know, they're all dead!
And we're gonna fry! That's much better!
translation: 而我们要被烧成灰！那可好多了！

original: Because we're going east through Northside Park. We'll find another transport. There has to be a topper in range.
translation: 因为我们要往东穿过北区公园。我们会找到另一架运输机。附近肯定还有直升机。
三角洲2号呼叫地狱火26，收到吗！
三角洲2号呼叫地狱火26，请回答！

original: What are you doing? He's gone!
translation: 你在干什么？他已经走了！
三角洲2号呼叫总部，请回答！

original: WE'RE WAY TOO DEEP IN ENEMY TERRITORY!
Let's get out of the highway!

translation: 三角洲2号呼叫总部！请回答！

original: Delta 2, we need a pickup near Northside Park.
translation: 三角洲2号，我们需要在北区公园附近接应。

original: What do you want me to do?

translation: 派架飞机来接，你这蠢货！
派架飞机来接我们，求你了！

original: I don't think I can help you.
We're not going to make it.
This is HQ. You need a pickup near Northside Park?
translation: 这里是总部。你们需要在北区公园附近接应？
我们现在就在北区公园！

original: The closest chopper we've got is 20 miles away.
translation: 我们最近的直升机在20英里外。

original: God has nothing to do with this.
We just got out of Northside Park by the East Gate.
translation: 我们刚从北区公园东门出来。

original: I don't think we can reach you in time and land in a hot zone.
translation: 我觉得我们没法及时赶到你们那儿，还在交火区降落。

original: Yes, you can! We drive to you! You fly to us! We meet in the middle! Fairview Mall's main parking lot! Come on! Are your medals and pins worth anything, sir? Or are you the biggest coward I've ever met in my life?
translation: 你们能！我们开车过去！你们飞过来！我们在中间碰头！费尔维尤购物中心的主停车场！来啊！长官，你那些勋章胸章到底值不值钱？还是说，你是我这辈子见过最大的懦夫？

original: You've got heart, son. I'll give you that. Okay. Alright. Let's do it. But we're not gonna wait for you. If you're not there in five minutes, we're flying out.
translation: 你有种，小子，这点我认。好吧。行。就这么办。但我们不会等你们。五分钟内不到，我们就起飞。

original: We'll be there, and you better be too! Over!
translation: 我们一定到，你最好也到！完毕！

original: This is Flyboy One, do you copy?
translation: 这里是飞行小子一号，收到吗？

original: We need pick up immediately! We're in Northside Park!
translation: 我们需要立刻接应！我们在北区公园！

original: We're currently flying away from your location, but hold your ground for 30 minutes, soldier. A transport will rendezvous with you.
translation: 我们目前正飞离你们的位置，但坚持住30分钟，士兵。会有架运输机来接应你们。

original: DON'T GIVE ME YOUR BULLSHIT ROUTINE! WHO IS THIS?!
translation: 少跟我来这套鬼话！你是谁？！

original: This is General Sherman. What's your name?
translation: 我是谢尔曼将军。你叫什么名字？

original: Fuck you, that's my name! You're gonna nuke the city, you son of a bitch!
translation: 去你妈的，这就是我的名字！你要核平这座城市，你这狗娘养的！

original: Yes, I am, Coachada. We lost control of the city and we don't have a choice.
translation: 是的，科切塔。我们失去了对城市的控制，别无选择。

original: We're here! We're alive! Get us out of here!
translation: 我们到了！我们还活着！带我们离开这儿！

original: You have to take as many shortcuts as we can, or we're not going to make it.
translation: 你得多抄近路，能抄多少抄多少，否则我们赶不上。

original: Sherman and Coach Jaden, we've landed and we're not alone. When you're done cruising around, get your ass over here.
translation: 谢尔曼和科切塔，我们已降落，而且这儿不止我们。你们兜完风就赶紧滚过来。

original: We're almost there! Wait for us, sir!
translation: 我们快到了！等等我们，长官！

original: Goddammit! We'll wait as long as we can! Hurry up! Over!
translation: 他妈的！我们尽量等！快点！完毕！

original: What's the problem? Something's wrong with the... Talk and move at the same time, son! It's the hydraulic system, sir. Gotta check the pressure relief valves.
translation: 什么问题？……有点不对……边干边说，小子！是液压系统，长官。得检查泄压阀。

original: Boleski, give me an ETA. Five minutes, sir. You have two. They have the green light to drop the bomb. It's gonna blow whether we're here or not.
translation: 博莱斯基，给我个预计到达时间。五分钟，长官。你只有两分钟。他们已获准投弹。不管我们在不在，它都会炸。

original: We're working on it! You two just keep covering your side!
translation: 我们在修了！你们俩守好自己那边！

original: Valesky! I got it, sir! Just gotta tighten this one up and reset- Just do it!
translation: 瓦列斯基！我搞定了，长官！只要把这个拧紧，再重启——快动手！

original: Leaving now would be a great idea!
